body.message:
Hello dear,

I wanted to let you know that I’m currently facing some issues with my work and, unfortunately, I have to resign from my position. Because of this, I may not have enough income to cover my rent.

Could you please let me know if it would be possible for me to leave at the end of my current contract? My contract is supposed to end on the 20th, and I believe I will need to leave on that day, as I won’t be able to afford the rent after that.

I’m sorry for the situation and I really appreciate your understanding. 🙏
